### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report only physical examination findings and specific sub-exams explicitly mentioned in the transcript. Do not infer or add details about unmentioned specific exams (e.g., neurological, dermatological).
[A-Section]: When discussing diagnoses or considerations, only establish causal links ("due to," "reason for") if explicitly stated by the provider. Otherwise, describe conditions as "comorbidities," "risk factors," or "considerations" as per the transcript.
